verdict.rationale: ReadMe's MCP Metrics page explicitly tracks calls made by AI agents/clients to a project's MCP server (calls, latency, failures, per-tool breakdown), which functions as dedicated AI-agent-traffic analytics distinct from human page-view metrics. However, this only covers MCP tool-call traffic, not a unified dashboard that tags/distinguishes AI crawlers or AI agent readers from human visitors across regular docs page views and API Metrics. Missing for 10: evidence of AI-vs-human classification within general docs pageview/API Metrics (not just MCP), and any UI showing side-by-side human vs agent traffic breakdown.
